## MigrationGraph.migrateMany() method

Execute migrations for multiple data items. The path is computed once and reused for all items.

**Signature:**

```typescript
migrateMany<T>(data: Iterable<unknown>, fromVersion: string, toVersion: string, options?: BatchMigrateOptions): BatchMigrationResult<T>;
```

## Example


```typescript
const results = graph.migrateMany(
  users,
  '1.0.0',
  '2.0.0',
  {
    continueOnError: true,
    onProgress: (done, total) => console.log(`${done}/${total}`)
  }
);
console.log(`Migrated ${results.succeeded}/${results.total}`);
```
